If your instructors haven't suggested it, bring a journal with you while you ride. Whenever you hit a curve or a corner that you're having trouble with, draw out the curve and draw lines to help you learn what angle you need to take it in. Then hit that corner again and again and again until you've got it down. I used to head out to a national park near me that had lots of curvy roads.
